description:
Make the top-level `snapshotVersion` content-derived and content-complete so the already-built 1599 "unchanged" fast-path (`src/main/mobile/bridge/snapshot-request.ts:64-66`) actually fires in steady state.

Current bug: `buildSnapshotVersion` (`src/main/mobile/sprintengine/snapshot.ts:1432`) is a content hash, but the top-level hashed value folds `updatedAt: generatedAt` where `generatedAt = new Date().toISOString()` is stamped per read (`snapshot.ts:281,318-323`). So the top-level version changes on every generation and the phone's If-None-Match never matches on a full snapshot. The top-level hash also currently OMITS `backlog` and `automations`.

Do exactly this:
1. Remove any per-read wall-clock (`generatedAt` / timestamps) from the TOP-LEVEL hashed value. `generatedAt` may still be emitted in the snapshot object for display; it just must not feed the hash.
2. Fold `backlog` and `automations` content into the top-level hashed value so backlog-only and automations-only changes still bump the version.
3. Keep `buildSnapshotVersion` signature and the `snap_` prefix unchanged. Keep per-engine sub-version hashing (`snapshot.ts:450-458`) and the MC-1567 invariant (a sprint-engine task/artifact/status change still bumps the top-level version).
4. Do NOT change the wire shape, protocol version (stays v2), `dispatchSnapshotRequest`, `filterToDefaultSnapshotStatePaths`, or the shedding ladder.

Ship unit tests (see acceptance). Update the two KG notes named below in this same publish.
